# StepIndicator

> Lede 0.7.2's docs for StepIndicator, installed with it. Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/step-indicator.md

An `<ol>` of steps that marks the current one with `aria-current="step"`. Narrow screens show only its summary, such as "Step 2 of 3 · Preferences".

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @lede/step-indicator
```

The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. It also installs the items [`lede-theme`](lede-theme.md) and [`lede-utils`](lede-utils.md). The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.7.2/step-indicator.json.

## Import

```tsx
import { StepIndicator } from '@/components/lede/blocks/step-indicator';
```

## Files and exports

| Installs to | Import from | Exports |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `components/lede/blocks/step-indicator.tsx` | `@/components/lede/blocks/step-indicator` | `StepIndicator` (component), `StepIndicatorProps` (type) |

## Props

A group named "Progress" holding an ordered list with `aria-current="step"`. Summary first: narrow screens show and read only "Step 2 of 3 · Preferences", and the full list replaces it when there is room.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` (required) | `string[]` |  | Step names, in order. |
| `current` (required) | `number` |  | Zero-based index of the current step. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Example

The smallest working use, from the docs site:

```tsx
import { StepIndicator } from '@/components/lede/blocks/step-indicator';

export function SetupProgress({ step }: { step: number }) {
  return <StepIndicator steps={['Account', 'Preferences', 'Review']} current={step} />;
}
```

Docs: [Blocks](https://lede.cloudcompute.com/blocks.md).
